reasoning: Google has not yet released Gemini 3.0 as of April 2025; fitting three distinct point releases (3.0, 3.1, 3.2) into the next ~13 months is plausible but far from guaranteed. The timeline requires Google to release 3.0, then 3.1, then 3.2—all within 13 months—which leaves limited margin for delays.
The resolution criteria explicitly exclude releases labeled as a new flagship generation (e.g., Gemini 4) if not explicitly designated as 3.2.
